findings.claim: TXN Analog segment revenue accelerated from $3.9B (+22% YoY) in Q1 2026 to $4.37B (+26% YoY) in Q2 2026.
findings.source: TI reports first quarter 2026 financial results (investor.ti.com press release); Texas Instruments Q2 FY 2026 Earnings Climb on Broad-based Analog Growth (Futurum)

findings.claim: TXN Embedded Processing segment revenue grew from $723M (+12% YoY) in Q1 2026 to $788M (+16% YoY) in Q2 2026 — smaller and growing slower than the Analog segment.
findings.source: TI reports first quarter 2026 financial results (investor.ti.com); Texas Instruments Q2 FY 2026 Earnings Climb on Broad-based Analog Growth (Futurum)

findings.claim: Texas Instruments held the largest analog semiconductor market share at 17.8% in 2025, positioning it as market leader ahead of peers.
In the broader analog semiconductor market, unit shipment growth (6.98% CAGR 2026-2031) is projected to outpace revenue growth, indicating persistent price pressure in commodity analog categories.
findings.source: Analog Semiconductor Market Size, Share & Research Report (Coherent Market Insights / GMInsights)

findings.claim: TI is expanding its Sherman, Texas 300mm analog fab with a second cleanroom module, adding 20,000 wafer starts per month by 2028, reinforcing its scale-driven cost-leadership position in analog/power management.
findings.source: Analog Semiconductors Market Size & Share 2026-2035 — competitive positioning section (GMInsights)

findings.claim: TXN's Industrial end market grew ~30% YoY in Q1 2026, driven by depletion of customer inventory and ramp of new systems with higher secular content.
findings.source: Texas Instruments Q1 FY 2026: Data Center and Industrial Demand Lift Outlook (Futurum)

findings.claim: TXN's Automotive end market returned to mid-teens YoY growth in Q2 2026 (upper-single-digit sequential), an inflection led by China EV/hybrid demand and customers replenishing inventory from unsustainably low levels.
findings.source: Texas Instruments Incorporated Q2 2026 Earnings Call Summary (Yahoo Finance / Investing.com transcript)

findings.claim: TXN's Personal Electronics end market was flat YoY in Q2 2026 (up low-single-digits sequentially), the weakest of TXN's end markets.
findings.source: Texas Instruments Incorporated Q2 2026 Earnings Call Summary (Yahoo Finance)

findings.claim: TXN's Communications Equipment end market grew ~25% YoY and more than 30% sequentially in Q2 2026.
findings.source: Texas Instruments Incorporated Q2 2026 Earnings Call Summary (Yahoo Finance)

findings.claim: Data center demand (within Enterprise Systems) surged ~90% YoY in Q1 2026 and TI's data center revenue doubled YoY in Q2 2026, driven by GPU power-delivery content; TI's addressable analog+embedded data center TAM is estimated to grow from $7.5B in 2025 to $12.5B in 2026, with TI's ~$1.5B 2025 data center revenue implying roughly 20% share of that TAM.
findings.source: Texas Instruments Q1 FY 2026: Data Center and Industrial Demand Lift Outlook (Futurum); Texas Instruments Stock Up 58% This Year as Data Center Revenue Grows 90% Year Over Year (TIKR.com)

findings.claim: Management guided to "outgrow the market" across industrial, data center and automotive markets in both 2026 and 2027, without committing to a fixed numerical growth rate.
findings.source: Earnings call transcript: Texas Instruments Q1 2026 beats forecasts (Investing.com)

findings.claim: In the competing microcontroller/embedded segment, Infineon Technologies led global market share at 21.3% in 2024, ahead of TXN — unlike its #1 analog position, TXN is not the share leader in embedded/MCU.
findings.source: What is Competitive Landscape of Texas Instruments Company? (MatrixBCG.com)
